scope: First frozen-backbone compact wake-head experiment; development only
model_choice: Quiet-bound8bit export frozen by numeric/fidelity only, not detector scores.6bit grid failed prespecifiedcosinegate and is rejected.
frontend: Exact512FFT window and257x32melmatrix,160samplehop,80dBfloor per1760sample block;8newframes per1280PCM/80ms. Native host versus source graph verified training-only.
data: Existing source/voice partitions; training+validation only.2normal-speed TTS variants: original quiet and room/gain/noise augmentation. Same human/environment source partitions, only training for fitting; no reserved testing read.
labels: Positive whole-phrase end uses existing synthesis/RMS metadata. Random head end .03.. .32seconds after label; reportendpointuncertainty. Negatives sample across all source windows.
head: 16x96byte embedding history asfloat/128,Conv2D24kernel(3,96)ReLU,MaxPool(14,1),Dense16ReLU,Dense1sigmoid. Parameter count measured at training.
selection: INT8 validation only:19thresholdgrid,<=.5continuousevents/hour andreportallconfusing-phrasegroups; preferstrict<=1%percorpus and>=95%recall. Freeze threshold/checkpointbefore paired/longregressions. No acceptanceclaimed without matchedphysical/human/resource/echo/reconnect tests.

event_policy.selection_order: Prefer strict eligible max macro recall; if none, continuous-only max macro recall is diagnostic, never acceptance; select checkpoint by same validation criteria. Ties lower FAR, then lower confusing-corpus rate, then earlier checkpoint.
